summary: TherapiShots increment E2E PASSED. Backend: 34/34 pytest pass — covers config, auth (18+ gate, short-pw, dup, login, /me, invalid token, demo user login), check-ins with NEW multiple-per-day behaviour (todays_count increments, todays_entries list ordered by created_at, todays_mood reflects LATEST), today/insights (daily_moods has 7 items with last-of-day mood)/pulse/progress, NEW psychologists (list, language filter, detail with availability slots, 404), NEW bookings (mock payment paid+MOCK- txn id, invalid slot 400, invalid session_type 400, invalid psych 404, list, cancel sets status cancelled, cancel-missing 404), and auth enforcement across 6 protected endpoints incl. /psychologists & /bookings. Frontend (Expo web preview @ EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, mobile viewport 390x844): demo login works, Today screen inline MoodSelector renders in EXACTLY 3 columns (bounding-box x=[40,148,255]), all 9 mood tiles present, tapping a mood quick-logs a check-in (todays_count goes 1->2 in body), Today's check-ins card lists entries with times, 'Add a note or context' button visible, Insights 'Your last 7 days' mood strip renders with 7 daily-mood entries + emoji per day, Support -> Find a psychologist lists 4 cards, tapping a card opens detail with session-type chips + 19 slots, selecting Video + first slot + 'Confirm & pay' shows 'Your session is confirmed' with 'Paid (mock)' label, View my appointments lists the booking, Cancel booking flips status to 'Cancelled'.

ui_bugs.issue: The custom <Card> component appears to NOT forward the testID prop to its underlying View — so [data-testid="todays-entries"] and [data-testid="quicklog-saved"] return 0 nodes in DOM even though the elements render visually. Purely cosmetic (testing-only) issue; user-visible behaviour is correct. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:72, 87.

action_items: OPTIONAL LOW-PRIORITY: Ensure the custom <Card> component forwards `testID` to its root <View> so automated tests can select [data-testid="todays-entries"] and [data-testid="quicklog-saved"]. All user-facing behaviour already works correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: multiple check-ins per day are now correctly appended (db.checkins.insert_one) and /api/today returns todays_entries sorted by created_at asc + todays_mood = last entry. Matches the spec exactly.
server.py L950-967: /api/psychologists correctly renames Mongo `_id` to `id` and drops _id from response (no ObjectId leakage).
server.py L983-1015: /api/bookings mock payment is clearly labelled (provider=mock, MOCK- prefixed transaction_id, disclaimer 'Simulated payment — no real charge'). Server-side stub only — good.
server.py L927-939: gen_availability is deterministic per psychologist slug — so slot IDs are stable between GET /psychologists/{id} and POST /bookings. Good design for the mock flow.
MoodSelector.tsx L48: cols=3 hardcoded and horizontal padding math produces 3-column layout on mobile viewport (verified via bounding boxes).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_therapishots_api.py (rewrote to cover psychologists, bookings, multiple check-ins/day, daily_moods)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (Today inline mood grid, quick-log, Insights 7-day strip, Support -> Psychologists -> detail -> Confirm&pay -> Appointments -> Cancel)

seed_data_creation: Registration auto-seeds ~42 days of correlated mood+health history per new user. Startup hook seeds 4 demo psychologists into db.psychologists (idempotent). Test fixture creates a fresh test_<uuid>@therapishots.app user per session — demo user is not modified. During frontend test, 2 bookings were created for demo@therapishots.app then 1 was cancelled (leaves 1 confirmed + 1 cancelled).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Multiple check-ins per day are now intentional — do NOT assert 'replace' behaviour. /api/today.todays_entries is ordered by created_at asc and todays_mood = last entry. /api/insights.daily_moods is a fixed 7-item array (oldest first, today last), mood may be null for empty days. Psychologist IDs are Mongo ObjectIds from db.psychologists. Slot IDs are deterministic per slug (format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:00) — regenerate via GET /psychologists/{id} before booking (do not cache across days). Payment is MOCKED server-side (provider='mock'). Demo user demo@therapishots.app / secret123 already has bookings from this run — factor into any list-count assertions.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no blocking issues found. The only observation is a minor testID-forwarding gap in the custom <Card> component, which does not affect users.
